actions.action: Track moved highlights with verifiable passage identity.
actions.mechanism: Separate immutable original anchors from revision-specific locations; require identity evidence rather than textual resemblance.
actions.implementation: Store original text, revision, offsets, and context. Reattach only when preserved passage IDs or verified edit history establish unchanged passage identity.
actions.check: Move a paragraph: its notes follow with recorded evidence. Duplicate an identical sentence: absent distinguishing provenance, matching remains ambiguous.
actions.risk: Imported revisions may lack sufficient identity evidence.

actions.action: Require explicit resolution of changed or ambiguous passages.
actions.mechanism: Candidate locations remain proposals until the reader confirms them; similarity never authorizes attachment.
actions.implementation: Show original and candidate passages side by side, highlighting differences and displaying section paths and surrounding context. Offer confirm, reject, and unresolved.
actions.check: Change “must” to “must not”: require confirmation. Show identical repeated sentences as separate candidates, not one automatic match.
actions.risk: Frequent edits can create substantial review work.

actions.action: Keep deleted highlights accessible with their notes.
actions.mechanism: A missing passage becomes an explicit historical annotation, not a forced attachment or discarded note.
actions.implementation: Retain original text and revision permanently with the note. Show “deleted” only with deletion evidence; otherwise show “unresolved.” Compare against the corresponding new section.
actions.check: Delete a highlighted paragraph: its note remains searchable, opens the original passage, and has no current attachment.
actions.risk: Retained passages require storage and appropriate access controls.

actions.action: Scope attachment corrections to explicit revisions.
actions.mechanism: Versioned binding decisions prevent a correction in one revision from silently changing later attachments.
actions.implementation: Append binding events with source revision, target revision, evidence, and user decision. Default corrections to one revision; extending them requires revalidation per revision.
actions.check: Correct revision B after C exists: C stays unchanged. Extend toward C containing a meaning-changing edit: attachment requires review.
actions.risk: Revision branches and conflicting corrections complicate the interface.
